blocking_issues: The draft is close, but it is not ready to stage because it over-infers covert/embedded status from a very thin source record and includes one source-facing card fact.
format_errors: `INSTRUCTION: ... no other witnessed events exist in the record` is source-facing meta language inside the Honcho card. Rephrase as an in-world boundary without referring to the record.
revision_instructions: Replace the speculative embedded/posing role with a narrower version: `ROLE: collective military force named only in narration during the Marmola space battle`.

Keep the Imperial House relationship but remove covert language: `RELATIONSHIP: imperial_house (Imperial House): apparent allies or subordinates; their betrayal benefits the Imperial House during the Marmola battle`.

Rephrase the record-facing instruction to something like: `BOUNDARY: no confirmed actions beyond the Marmola betrayal and its immediate battle consequence; do not invent later service, command structure, or motives`.
unsupported_claims: `ROLE: Imperial-aligned operative force embedded within or posing as members of an anti-Imperial coalition...` overstates the bundle. The source supports an unexpected betrayal that benefits the Imperial House; it does not establish that the Black Endoguard were operatives, embedded agents, posing as coalition members, or that the betrayed side was an anti-Imperial coalition.

`RELATIONSHIP: imperial_house (Imperial House): ... is consistent with covert Imperial alignment` is too speculative. The source supports apparent alliance/subordination or benefit to Imperial House interests, not covert alignment as a confirmed characterization.
